instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park with green grass and blurred trees, the bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R1) on the left and the woman with a ponytail in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) on the right crouch in a line, pulling a thick yellow rope. The bald man (R1) pulls while shouting joyfully with a wide-open mouth, while the woman (R2) stands behind him, pulling with a happy smile. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene with warm tones, soft shadows, and a shallow depth of field.
